justification: Both surfaces carry crowded low-relief animal imagery in stacked horizontal registers, including profile quadrupeds with heads turned toward the viewer, a snarling predator head at the lower edge, and bird forms, all rendered in the same raised-outline, flat-interior schematic convention with similar squat proportions. The clearest difference is that B adds a strongly ordered top register of repeated arched/animal signs above a banded chevron strip and a large frontal bird and plant-like motif below, whereas A is a single dense mass of interlocking animals without that hierarchical banding.
